description: This file contains implementation of tree walk functions for a Git-like version control system, including functions to decode, initialize, traverse, and manipulate tree objects, as well as handling symlinks and pathspec matching.

methods.name: int decode_tree_entry(struct tree_desc * desc,const char * buf,unsigned long size,struct strbuf * err)
methods.description: Decodes a single entry from a tree object buffer, extracting path, mode, and object ID.

methods.name: int init_tree_desc_internal(struct tree_desc * desc,const struct object_id * oid,const void * buffer,unsigned long size,struct strbuf * err,enum tree_desc_flags flags)
methods.description: Initializes a tree_desc structure with buffer data and parameters, decoding the first tree entry if present.

methods.name: void init_tree_desc(struct tree_desc * desc,const struct object_id * tree_oid,const void * buffer,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Initializes a tree_desc with a given object ID and buffer, terminating with die() on errors.

methods.name: int init_tree_desc_gently(struct tree_desc * desc,const struct object_id * oid,const void * buffer,unsigned long size,enum tree_desc_flags flags)
methods.description: Like init_tree_desc but errors are reported via error() and the function returns an int status.

methods.name: void * fill_tree_descriptor(struct repository * r,struct tree_desc * desc,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Reads a tree object from the repository, initializes a tree_desc, and returns its buffer.

methods.name: int get_tree_entry(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * tree_oid,const char * name,struct object_id * oid,unsigned short * mode)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific entry from a tree object by its path, following directories as needed.

methods.name: enum:get_oid_result get_tree_entry_follow_symlinks(struct repository * r,struct object_id * tree_oid,const char * name,struct object_id * result,struct strbuf * result_path,unsigned short * mode)
methods.description: Traverses the repository tree following symlinks, resolving paths outside the repository or pointing inside.

methods.name: int traverse_trees(struct index_state * istate,int n,struct tree_desc * t,struct traverse_info * info)
methods.description: Recursively traverses multiple trees with pathspec filtering, collecting statistics and handling errors.

methods.name: int tree_entry(struct tree_desc * desc,struct name_entry * entry)
methods.description: Extracts the current entry from a tree_desc, advancing the descriptor.

methods.name: int tree_entry_gently(struct tree_desc * desc,struct name_entry * entry)
methods.description: Similar to tree_entry but does not die on errors, instead returns a status.

methods.name: void setup_traverse_info(struct traverse_info * info,const char * base)
methods.description: Initializes traversal info structure for directory walking.

methods.name: char * make_traverse_path(char * path,size_t pathlen,const struct traverse_info * info,const char * name,size_t namelen)
methods.description: Constructs a traversal path string based on parent info and entry name.

methods.name: enum:interesting tree_entry_interesting(struct index_state * istate,const struct name_entry * entry,struct strbuf * base,const struct pathspec * ps)
methods.description: Determines if a tree entry matches the given pathspecs and interest criteria.

methods.name: int basecmp(const struct pathspec_item * item,const char * base,const char * match,int len)
int check_entry_match(const char * a,int a_len,const char * b,int b_len)
enum:interesting do_match(struct index_state * istate,const struct name_entry * entry,struct strbuf * base,const struct pathspec * ps,int exclude)
void entry_clear(struct name_entry * a)
void entry_extract(struct tree_desc * t,struct name_entry * a)
void extended_entry_extract(struct tree_desc_x * t,struct name_entry * a,const char * first,int first_len)
int find_tree_entry(struct repository * r,struct tree_desc * t,const char * name,struct object_id * result,unsigned short * mode)
void free_extended_entry(struct tree_desc_x * t)
int match_dir_prefix(const struct pathspec_item * item,const char * base,const char * match,int matchlen)
int match_entry(const struct pathspec_item * item,const struct name_entry * entry,int pathlen,const char * match,int matchlen,enum interesting * never_interesting)
int match_wildcard_base(const struct pathspec_item * item,const char * base,int baselen,int * matched)
int prune_traversal(struct index_state * istate,struct name_entry * e,struct traverse_info * info,struct strbuf * base,int still_interesting)
void strbuf_make_traverse_path(struct strbuf * out,const struct traverse_info * info,const char * name,size_t namelen)
void trace2_traverse_trees_statistics_atexit(void)
void update_extended_entry(struct tree_desc_x * t,struct name_entry * a)
void update_tree_entry(struct tree_desc * desc)
int update_tree_entry_gently(struct tree_desc * desc)
